deploybot: Starting deploy to staging — env=staging tag=v1.42.0 sha=abc1234 (started by @jordan)
jordan: kicking off premerge: smoke + integration checks
deploybot: PREMERGE CHECKS: BLOCKED — failures detected (blocking deploy). See summary below and logs link.

deploybot: Failed checks: integration-tests (1/12 failed), qa-smoke (timeout)
Logs: https://ci.internal/212675/abc1234

kevin: which integration test failed?
deploybot: integration-tests: test_connectivity::test_persistent_kv failed on shard-3 with AssertionError
qa-smoke: step 'load homepage' timed out after 120s on headless-chrome-5

maya: on it — looks like a flaky infra timeout. @ben can you grab shard-3 logs?
ben: pulling logs now, looks like KV connection attempts spiked during migration window. ETA 15m to dig in.
jordan: if this won't be green fast, do we pin back to v1.41.9 or attempt quick rerun after a fix?
maya: prefer a quick infra patch + rerun if <30m. Pin/rollback if we need more time.
ben: I can push a small timeout bump patch (hotfix/kv-timeout) and requeue CI.
jordan: ok please push and then trigger rerun. @deploybot rerun presubmit for sha=abc1234
deploybot: Received rerun request from jordan. Triggering CI rerun (job id 2126758501). Will post updates.
deploybot: CI rerun still failing (same test). Escalating to eng-infra, assigning ben as oncall for flaky investigations. :eyes:
ben: increasing qa-smoke timeout to 180s in deploy config and requeueing. Pushing hotfix branch now.
deploybot: Rerun queued (job id 2126758605) after hotfix patch.
deploybot: Rerun result: PASSED — all blocking checks green. Continuing deploy to staging.
jordan: awesome, thanks. Proceeding. Will schedule canary in tomorrow's change window and include a note about the timeout tweak.
maya: adding release note: "Mitigation for QA smoke flake: increased timeout for homepage load; no DB schema changes."
ben: filing follow-up ticket for root cause investigation INF-842.
jordan: thanks team. :thumbsup:
